findings.topic: Native source ordering is real but narrow
findings.observation: Cycle95 has zero new-comparator mismatches on 3,788 supported queries and 954/954 historical old-head0 ordered supports. All426 support changes among477 paired historical padding queries are reproduced; A/B have319/280 distinct supports across clock. The predeclared synthetic edit has zero response, and all1,900 transfer padding queries are unsupported because of unknown active keys.
findings.limit: This is head0/pad151643/30 discovery token IDs/L512 ordering only. The universal subset argument applies to the new bank-independent score contract, not all-history bit parity with the old NumPy reader. No values, soft attention mass, contextual stream, image, or arbitrary prompt closure is supplied.

findings.topic: History reader roles separate route from payload
findings.observation: Reciprocal supplied Qwen witnesses transport their answer under V17..27 substitution while the first allocation stays exact; the subsequent MLP changes later queries/allocations. K-only and split value groups have asymmetric or incomplete effects.
findings.limit: All original maps/state remain paid. Fixed first addresses do not identify payload computation or a sufficient future state. The mechanism is not a universal AND or a general contextual initializer.

findings.topic: Foretelling does not eliminate operand formation
findings.observation: A small prospective second-order weight program improves seven of eight read predictions at the largest reported dose and five of eight native-consumer outcomes against first order; a countertrend remains.
findings.limit: Nineteen dense maps, JVP/compiler work, a specific parent/direction, baseline and native consumer are paid. Small stored coefficients are not a general prompt/context producer.

findings.topic: Actual symbolic recurrence has supplied operands
findings.observation: A compact discrete program advances its own register state over the qualified instruction windows. Route bits and Boolean word laws replace a bounded native feedback computation.
findings.limit: Eight structured64-bit registers, flags, raw15-byte windows, horizon and qualified applicability are supplied. Auxiliary soft heads are not emulated; broader scan lowering retains learned parameter work. No language-to-register initializer follows.

findings.observation: cMachine four-digit restoration jumps from364/2048 to2019/2048 with preceding native operands, while equals-position native readout alone gives367/2048; both give2047/2048. Finite layout effects and countertrends are retained. Broad gate/up reductions can save nominal work while losing structured answers; bounded state charts can preserve native wrong answers.
findings.limit: Neither native restoration nor full-byte state coverage is a cheap source-dependent producer, and first-read repair does not imply successor closure.

findings.topic: Discovery families are useful instruments, not imported semantics
findings.observation: Feature/rewrite unions and graph/controller experiments expose nontrivial small mechanisms and countertrends, including competitive random subsets.
findings.limit: Features, grammars, extractors, controllers or native scores are supplied. They do not establish an economical native prompt-to-state or state-to-pixel law.

findings.topic: Authority is not a discovery stop gate
findings.observation: Finite transcripts do not establish a global Hankel rank/closure claim; independent structural bounds can do so. The capability documents explicitly retain general semantic-frontend and zero-neural-generation gaps.
findings.limit: Lack of a global proof does not prohibit source-bound exploratory candidates. Another toy authority panel or native-image Hankel campaign is not selected.

decision.status: One bounded source-derived ordering-update feasibility cut remains justified; no complete generator exists.
decision.selectedQuestion: Can the same qualified Cycle95 ordering relation be executed as an exact economical own-history integer update program, rather than stored independently at every clock?
decision.fixedScope: Same head0, pad151643,30 discovery IDs,L512 and score/tie contract. No vocab/head/domain expansion, seed/rank/format search, new neural evaluation, or image continuation.
decision.grammar: One fixed COPY(sourceStart_u16,length_u16)5-byte / INSERT(tokenIndex_u16)3-byte grammar with a2-byte operation count per clock, compiled from all qualified source permutations. Full all-ordinal reconstruction is an integrity proof, not an output-quality gate.
decision.initialEvaluatorCaution: Expanding every global order per serving packet would pay3,924,480 order expansions/inverse updates, max30,660-byte order plus30,720-byte inverse index, buffers and runtime. Smaller storage could be slower.

sparseRankAddendum.chronology: Root proposed this algebraic evaluator refinement after the substantive survey route recommendation and before any recurrence test/stage/run. It changes the sole evaluator, not the fixed grammar/domain. Updated code has not been content-reviewed as part of this survey.
sparseRankAddendum.law: A COPY source interval [a,a+l) emitted at target start b maps each old ordinal r in it to r+(b-a). Disjoint complete source coverage permits binary search over source-sorted intervals; INSERT gives the new token candidate rank. Maintain only admitted history-key ranks, not the full candidate universe, online.
sparseRankAddendum.requirements: Validate source intervals as a complete disjoint partition and all target counts/insert identities. Charge interval starts/deltas, offsets/sentinels, insert-rank lookup, load sorting/validation, each search/rank update and retained history. Preserve strict unknown-token refusal and independent control state. Full-order decode remains separately paid proof.
sparseRankAddendum.integerScope: At most15,330 candidates; source/target ordinals fit uint16 and signed rank deltas fit int16.

decision.decisiveInterpretation: Exact execution plus measured bytes/load/serving work can identify reusable discrete structure for one native read family. A poor compression/runtime result is evidence about this grammar/evaluator/specimen, not absence of symbolic computation.
decision.strongerObjectCaveat: The total order also orders alternatives at the same key position that cannot coexist in a legal history. Failure to compress this stronger object does not exclude a cheaper history-applicable comparison predicate.
decision.afterThisCut: Do not default to a codec/head/vocabulary expansion campaign. The next goal-facing dependency is contextual payload/read-state formation: weights, values/mixing and their successor state, then the remaining encoder/denoiser/pixel path. No newly surveyed artifact supplies that complete construction.
